evidence: FY2025 lender-base EBITDA was $225.344m, versus $179.358m in FY2024.
credit_consequence: Supports interim debt service, but includes accepted noncash/acquisition adjustments.
residual_risk: Adjustment acceptance is not cash realization.

evidence: FY2025 CFO/FCF were $164.897m/$102.255m and 73.2%/45.4% of lender-base EBITDA.
credit_consequence: Improves confidence versus FY2024's weaker conversion.
residual_risk: Seasonality and acquisition perimeter still limit comparability.

evidence: Selected Base minimum all-in liquidity is $263.902m over the forecast, including the January 31, 2026 opening position.
credit_consequence: Provides timing and operating-liquidity support, not debt repayment.
residual_risk: Cash eligibility and drawability require final documents; a revolver draw increases or reallocates funded debt.

evidence: 7.5% annual amortization plus a 50% ECF sweep; Base realizes $238.125m scheduled principal and $57.292m sweep cumulatively from February 1, 2026 through January 31, 2031.
credit_consequence: These are payment mechanisms applied to operating cash, not repayment sources.
protection_or_mitigant: Payment ordering, sweep definition, and distribution restrictions.
residual_risk: Base still leaves a $324.780m bank-debt gap at January 31, 2031.

evidence: Opening gross leverage is 3.2285x, close to the inclusive 3.25x warning.
credit_consequence: Small earnings or debt variance can trigger immediate attention.
protection_or_mitigant: No cash netting; final payoff; closing EBITDA/debt certificate.

evidence: Tyman integration, plant stabilization, and $302.284m impairment reduce forecast confidence.
credit_consequence: Margin underperformance drives early warning and covenant pressure.
protection_or_mitigant: Plant KPI, gross-margin bridge, and integration milestones.
residual_risk: Impairment addback is mathematical but remains an adverse signal.

evidence: FY2025 DIO rose to 72.22 days and capex to $62.642m; DPO remains N/D.
credit_consequence: Cash conversion can weaken despite reported EBITDA.
protection_or_mitigant: Aging, purchase/AP bridge, and maintenance-capex schedule.
residual_risk: No zero AP/other-WC assumption or unsupported capex cut.

evidence: Moderate unmitigated/mitigated leverage peaks at 4.4893x/4.4670x and breaches on October 31, 2026; minimum liquidity remains $165.078m/$168.937m and no payment failure occurs.
credit_consequence: Conditional approval accepts early lender intervention, not covenant survival; mitigation does not restore compliance and no automatic waiver is assumed.
protection_or_mitigant: Immediate reporting, distribution stop, corrective plan, and resize/non-debt-capital/restructure/no-close test if moderate is near expected case.
residual_risk: A breach remains possible while liquidity and payment capacity are available; covenant is not loosened to remove it.

evidence: Severe unmitigated liquidity reaches zero and cash-interest fails on 2027-12-31.
credit_consequence: The selected structure is not resilient to severe stress.
protection_or_mitigant: Early warnings, reporting, distribution controls, and no-waiver analysis.
residual_risk: Mitigations delay but do not eliminate severe failure.

evidence: Base unsupported bank-debt maturity gap is $324.780m at January 31, 2031.
credit_consequence: Operating cash does not self-liquidate the term; refinancing is not a demonstrated repayment source.
protection_or_mitigant: Maturity plan begins at least 24 months early and escalates by 12 months.
residual_risk: No takeout or refinancing proceeds are assumed; any refinancing is separately underwritten.

evidence: Cash-flow reporting-control material weakness remained open at FY2025 year-end.
credit_consequence: Reduces confidence in forecast cash classification and compliance reporting.
protection_or_mitigant: Remediation milestones, testing evidence, and audit-committee reporting.

credit_consequence: Potential collateral realization, business-sale proceeds, and other default recoveries are secondary backstops only.
protection_or_mitigant: Guarantees, collateral, perfection, priority, entity allocation, appraisal, claims, and realization-cost diligence.
residual_risk: Full consolidated access is only a ceiling sensitivity; illustrative recovery is not official recovery.

evidence: At July 31, 2029, existing/selected total funded debt is $495.368m/$514.754m, so selected is $19.386m higher. Existing matures August 1, 2029 with a $432.749m bank-debt gap; amendment economics are N/D.
credit_consequence: Avoids refinancing fees and near-term debt expansion; selected offers no faster same-horizon deleveraging.
protection_or_mitigant: Use as mandatory fallback if Phase 10 conditions fail.
residual_risk: Selected's lower $324.780m gap at January 31, 2031 partly reflects about 18 additional months and is not directly comparable.
